description_en: Deletes one or more compliance packages
description_zh: 删除指定合规包。删除合规包后，该合规包的检查结果和检查报告也自动被删除
kebab_example: aliyun config delete-compliance-packs --compliance-pack-ids cp-541e626622af00870000 --client-token AAAAAdDWBF20000 --delete-rule false --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteCompliancePacks

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the compliance package. Separate multiple compliance package IDs with commas (,).

For more information about how to obtain the ID of a compliance package, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/263332.html
parameters.help_zh:
合规包ID。多个合规包ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔。

关于如何获取合规包ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/263332.html
parameters.name: compliance_pack_ids

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The `token` can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。`ClientToken`只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to delete the rules in the compliance package. Valid values:

- true: The rules are deleted.

- false (default): The rules are not deleted
parameters.help_zh:
删除合规包时是否同时删除规则。取值：

- true：删除规则。

- false（默认值）：不删除规则
parameters.name: delete_rule
